title: Applied ML weekly notes - 2026-05-05
content:
Weekly applied-ml research notes (2026-05-05)

Attendees: Maya, Noah, Lena, Arjun, Priya (sync + async updates)

High level 
- Focus this week: quantization quality regressions, landing eval harness for onboarding, and streamlining model metadata flow to registry.
- Quick wins: discovered calibration fudge factor causing BLEU/ROUGE drop for code models when converting to int8; fixed in local runner.

Quantization (Maya/Noah)
- Experiments run: int8 static vs dynamic on rdx-code-3b and rdx-chat-7b-ft. Sequence lengths: 128/512/2048.
- Observations: static per-channel scale with per-token clipping reduced outliers on rdx-code-3b but introduced subtle tokenization-related shifts on string generation (missing closing braces ~0.8% -> target <0.2%).
- Root cause: legacy tokenizer post-processing combined with asymmetric quantization rounding in production conversion script.
- Action: patch conversion script to preserve post-tokenizer sentinel handling + add per-layer calibration sampling (see PR linked). Regression tests to be added to quantization CI.
- Next steps: run full-batch eval (1000 prompts) overnight with new patch; if stable, produce blueprint for Dedicated-reserved fleets to test at 99th percentile latency.

Evals & Onboarding (Lena/Arjun)
- Eval harness: merged baseline harness v0.9 into staging. Needs two things before promoting: (1) canonical prompt bank for safety/regression checks, (2) automated diff report for quality deltas (we have a prototype).
- Onboarding checklist updated: model card fields required = architecture, tokenizer, max_seq, kv-cache support, expected memory footprint, recommended quantization profile. Lena to draft template by 5/08.
- Case study: onboarding rdx-chat-7b-ft -> initial perplexity ok but hallucination score up vs reference on multi-turn tasks. Hypothesis: fine-tune data sharding changed system prompt attention. Arjun to run ablation.

Infrastructure & CI (Priya)
- CI flakiness: quant CI timing out on GPUs with heavy compilation paths. Priya will add lightweight mock runner for quick prechecks and mark heavy-e2e as nightly.
- Model registry: metadata pipeline occasionally drops custom tags from model packaging process. Working with registry team to add idempotent retry.

Decisions made
- Use per-layer calibration samples (50K tokens sampled from representative corpus) as default for int8 static quantization for community models.
- Add 'onboarding-blocker' label in Jira for regressions > 0.5% on core metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/EM) or any safety metric failures.

Action items (owners & ETA)
- Maya: run overnight full eval for rdx-code-3b with patched converter; report by 2026-05-06.
- Noah: add quantization regression tests into quant-ci and wire diff reporter (2026-05-07).
- Lena: draft onboarding model card template and canonical prompt bank seed (2026-05-08).
- Arjun: ablation on rdx-chat-7b-ft system prompt and report (2026-05-10).
- Priya: add mock runner to CI and update job labels (2026-05-06).

Blockers/Risks
- Nightly heavy-e2e still takes too long; slows feedback loop for quant changes. Consider sample-based smoke checks to reduce iteration time.
- Some community models lack deterministic tokenizers which complicates regression detection; add tokenizer acceptance tests to onboarding.

Notes / Loose thoughts
- Consider publishing a short internal playbook on "When to prefer dynamic vs static quantization" with examples and cost/quality tradeoffs.
- Explore calibrated asymmetric quantization for embedding layers separately; could reduce embedding norm drift.

Meeting follow-ups:
- Sync for PR review of converter patch on 2026-05-06 10:30am PT (Noah + Maya).
- Onboarding template review in next applied-ml sync (2026-05-12).

Quick links: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/214 | CI job: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/quant-ci/432 | JIRA: AM-1128

Notes saved as working doc; will tidy into Confluence if we need a canonical runbook.
